designer_note: The one star system of MVP-1 (GDD 36). Content id only — the persisted `world_id` UUID stays architect's. Every number here is a designer assumption; see docs/design/p1-01-ship-movement-design.md.

coordinate_space.note: Left-handed, Y up, +Z forward (Unity convention, ADR-0009 §1). Ecliptic = XZ plane. The spawn ring and markers below are symmetric, so their coordinates are unchanged by the handedness correction — only this sentence was wrong. Client transforms are float32; the boundary below is what keeps that safe without Floating Origin.

play_area.note: At 12 km a float32 world coordinate quantizes to 0.98 mm — 5x under the jitter threshold. Do not grow the play area past 50,000 m in any slice until techart lands Floating Origin.

spawn.assignment_rule: index0 = H(world_seed_le8 || actor_id_16bytes) % point_count, where H is the deterministic integer hash specified inside starfall-sim and pinned by fixed-input tests (ADR-0010 §4 — no external hash crate, so determinism is not delegated to a crate version). Then probe index0, index0+1, ... (mod point_count) for the first point with no active or lingering ship within clearance_m + hull_radius_m; if all 12 are occupied, use index0 offset outward along its radial by radial_offset_step_m * ceil(attempts / point_count).
spawn.note: Adjacent points are 1,294 m apart (~13 s of travel), opposite points 5,000 m (~39 s). The alternating Y teaches the player on the first screen that there is an up.

presence.note: A disconnected ship does not vanish. It coasts, the assist brings it to rest, and it stays visible for linger_seconds. Reconnecting inside the window resumes the SAME ship at its current position/velocity/orientation.

reference_markers_note: CLIENT-SIDE STATIC VISUALS ONLY. No server entity, no server state, no collision, no interaction, never in a snapshot. They exist because without a fixed object in view a player cannot tell whether the ship is moving — which would make this slice's stated goal ('눈으로 확인 가능') unverifiable.
